points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable CMake build passes in network-disabled container with CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT and JSON_ROOT configured; no complete documented build procedure was identified.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:108–110 parses case and output only, ignores --restart and report-level; :195–198 writes only two-line restart placeholders. Missing-file invocation exits nonzero with clear diagnostic.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMake builds separate mesh, solver, io and main files, but core physics/time stepping is concentrated in solver.cpp and restart logic is not implemented.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted C++ with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct internal external-solver wrapper found. Per trust policy no external similarity or authorship investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case parser and CGNS path are configuration driven; actual meshes and case inputs were used. General independent arbitrary-case tests were not run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: mesh.cpp:484 METIS; solver.cpp:131–172 neighbor halo exchange and :616–620,689 global reductions; submitted np2 and np8 NACA/Re20 runs agree in Cd. Global mesh is broadcast temporarily during setup then destroyed on return, not retained for iteration.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: First-order steady fallback and frozen transient gradients stabilize the supplied cases, but restart output lacks state and unrecognized CLI options are ignored; no independent stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight final directories/report pass structural validator and np2/np8 runs are submitted; no reliable restart test, clean unit-test suite or independent order validation was established.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Build succeeds with configured dependency roots, but no complete build instructions were found and required restart writer is a two-line stub. Generated result paths were curated from the tip while preserved in history.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
